Name: }bedrock.hier.mirror

Parameters.Name: pTargetHierarchy
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Target hierarchy name (If pSrcDim = pTgtDim, Default = pSrcHier | '_Clone')

Parameters.Name: pCreateMissingParents
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: If True, will create consolidated elements in the target hierarchy. (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pCreateMissingChildren
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: If True, will create children elements in the target hierarchy. (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pCreateUnspecifiedElements
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: If False, will only create elements specified by the filters (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pUnwind
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Unwind hierarchies after process (0 = Delete all elements, 1 = Unwind existing elements, 2 = Do not change existing elements. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
